facts.stepOrigin: Default ss_sampling_steps, shape_slat_sampling_steps, tex_slat_sampling_steps in the actually used official run_inference. No wrapper override.
facts.cameraAxes: Z-up world, own -Z view axis and own +Y image-up. Front camera(0,-d,0), right(+d,0,0), rear(0,+d,0). Right camera local image-X aligns world+Y, so object front appears on the left side of the right-side image.
facts.nativePreprocessing: Existing RGBA mask read unchanged. Entire square canvas LANCZOS-resized to512/1024, RGB premultiplied by alpha. No automatic per-view crop or independent subject normalization.
